geography_minor.subject: Geography
geography_minor.title: Economic Geography
units: Introduction to Economic Geography: meaning, definition, nature, scope, recent trends, relationship with Economics and other disciplines, economic activities and classification into primary, secondary and tertiary activities.
Resources: concepts and classification, natural resources, ferrous and non-ferrous minerals, world mineral distribution, energy resources, conservation and sustainable resource management.
Primary Activities: mining, forestry, fishing, agriculture, physical and socio-cultural controls on agriculture, spatial crop distribution, major world food crops and cash crops.

Secondary and Tertiary Activities: industrial location factors, iron and steel, fertilizer, chemical and paper industries, transport geography, factors controlling transport development, road, rail, water and air transport.
